newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM CEO to resign in August.
newsitem.headline: KLM CEO to resign in August.

text.p: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines said on Wednesday its President and Chief Executive Pieter Bouw planned to resign on August 5, 1997.
KLM's supervisory board said it regretted the surprise decision, adding that it planned to appoint KLM Chief Operating Officer Leo van Wijk, 50, to succeed Bouw, 55.
KLM said Bouw -- who has been KLM's president for over six years -- had long believed that the position of CEO and president should not be held too long by any one person.
With KLM about to implement a major restructuring programme to boost operating profits, Bouw felt the time was now ripe for a transfer of leadership, the airline said.
